title: dataset
description: A FROZEN selection of items. The dataset_id is the comparison contract: two metrics are only comparable if they name the same dataset_id. An item's identity is its item_id and source_sha256; its fields describe it and are not part of that identity (ADR-0003).

fieldset.description: the field set (data/fields/<fieldset>.yaml) that declares the items' fields

fields_sha256.description: one hash over every item's fields, so a change to them is visible

source_url.description: where materialize fetches the item from; its bytes must hash to source_sha256

fields.description: values of the dataset's declared fields
